coding_semantics.relevant: At least one original PDR personalization criterion can materially change when this unit changes.
coding_semantics.known: A task-specific value was visible to the product agent before its first clarification question. For full_persona this includes the supplied persona; for interactive it includes only the task instruction.
coding_semantics.asked: At least one saved clarification question directly targeted the unit. A bundled question may target multiple units.
coding_semantics.resolved: By the end of clarification, the condition contained a sufficiently specific value to constrain a deliverable decision. A no-strong-preference answer does not resolve a positive choice, but can resolve priority when it explicitly establishes that the option is secondary.
coding_semantics.reflected: The final report made a material decision traceable to the resolved value. Generic task-compliance or an unconfirmed agent inference is recorded in reflected_degree but does not set reflected=true.
coding_semantics.reflected_degree: One of substantial, partial, inferred_partial, generic_partial, or none.
coding_semantics.primary_rubric_mass: Non-overlapping accounting mass from criteria for which the unit is primary. It sums to 1.0 across units.
coding_semantics.influence_rubric_mass: Overlapping diagnostic mass from all criteria listing the unit as primary or secondary. It must not be summed across units.
coding_semantics.delta_tier: High when influence_rubric_mass is at least 0.10; medium when it is 0.05–0.0999; low otherwise. This is a pre-output rubric-coverage proxy, not an estimated causal effect.
